facts.summary: OWASP Juice Shop running on Express ^4.22.1 with Angular SPA frontend
facts.body: Confirmed OWASP Juice Shop. HTTP headers: Express ^4.22.1 revealed in 500 error pages. Angular SPA with main.js, polyfills.js, styles.css. Uses JWT authentication (RS256 via RSA key pair). SQLite database (Juice Shop default). Socket.IO for real-time communication.

Login at /rest/user/login returns JWT token signed with RS256. Public key exposed at /encryptionkeys/jwt.pub. Token payload includes user data (id, email, password hash, role, etc.). Default admin credentials: admin@juice-sh.op / admin123 (found by testing common passwords).

facts.summary: Sensitive data exposure via /rest/memories API endpoint
facts.body: GET /rest/memories returns 10 memory entries each with embedded full User objects including: email, MD5 password hash, role, deluxeToken, lastLoginIp, profileImage. No authentication required. Affected users: bjoern@owasp.org (deluxe), bjoern.kimminich@gmail.com (admin), ethereum@juice-sh.op (deluxe), john@juice-sh.op (customer), emma@juice-sh.op (customer).

facts.summary: Multiple directories exposed with directory listing enabled
facts.body: /ftp/ - contains sensitive documents (acquisitions plan, incident support KDBX, encrypted announcements, backup files). /ftp/quarantine/ - contains malware URL shortcut files. /encryptionkeys/ - contains JWT public key and premium subscription key.
Login with email='admin@juice-sh.op' and password='admin123' (or 'admin') successfully authenticates as admin role user. Returns JWT token granting administrative access.

facts.summary: REST API surface mapped with 25+ endpoints
facts.body: API endpoints at /api/* (Products, Feedbacks, Challenges, Quantitys, SecurityQuestions - public; Users, Cards, Complaints, SecurityAnswers - authenticated) and /rest/* (login, languages, memories, products/search - public; basket, change-password - authenticated; admin, order, product, consoles, tracks, tasks, country-mapping, image, cloud - exist but return 500).
